title: Studies on Environmental and Social Impact of Importing Renewable Energy under Lao PDR-Thailand-Malaysia-Singapore Power Integration Project
what_it_is: Studies on Environmental and Social Impact of Importing Renewable Energy under Lao PDR-Thailand-Malaysia-Singapore Power Integration Project

sections.label: Lao PDR hydropower impact reports
sections.summary: Lao PDR reviewed assessments and monitors compliance; a Member asks MTI to publish environment and social impact reports, and the EIA was shared with EMA.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Results from these assessments had been reviewed by the Lao PDR government before the projects were allowed to proceed.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Government agencies in the Lao PDR also undertake regular monitoring to ensure compliance with the safeguards and the mitigation measures put in place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Could I just ask whether the Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) can publish this environment impact report and also the social impact report; so, not just environment, to ensure that it does not impact the communities and the environment in Lao PDR?

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: There was an EIA which was prepared by the Chulalongkorn University's Environmental Research Institute and ERM Siam Company Limited.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The Lao PDR authorities shared the EIA report with the Energy Market Authority (EMA).

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: This report states that sufficient mitigation measures have been put in place to address the environmental and the social impact of the hydropower project.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Based on the Member's suggestion, I certainly will discuss it with my team to see whether there are any sensitivities in publishing it.
